newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Resolute has Bulong financing from Citibank.
newsitem.headline: Resolute has Bulong financing from Citibank.

text.p: Western Australian gold miner Resolute Ltd said on Tuesday it had finalised a funding package for the Bulong nickel project through Citibank NA.
Citibank had fully underwritten the project finance of A$120 million for Bulong and provided a further facility for cost over-runs, the company said.
The offer of finance followed sign-off on due diligence by Citibank and its independent engineers, Behre Dolbear of the United States, it said.

Commissioning of the plant was due to start in April next year with the schedule allowing for a build-up to full metal production of 9,000 tonnes of nickel and 700 tonnes of cobalt a year, Resolute said.

Bulong's total resource currently stood at 140 million tonnes of nickel laterite grading 1.0 percent nickel and 0.1 percent cobalt, making it the largest undeveloped nickel project in Australia, Resolute said.
Mineable reserves for an initial 26 year mine life had been delineated and there were sufficient remaining resources to expand mine life to more than 40 years, it said.

The board had committed to phase one of the project, with initial production to start at 9,000 tonnes of LME grade nickel cathode a year. The feasibility study had examined a phased upgrade to 22,200 tonnes a year in year three, it said.
The Bulong nickel project is 30 kilometres from Kalgoorlie in Western Australia.
